answer: Let trust flow from a few long-verified seed accounts along real payment edges. Each epoch, standing ripples outward only across edges backed by settled trades, and it thins with every hop. A farm of fresh names sits behind a narrow ridge: inside the cluster the names can trade among themselves forever, but only two or three edges cross to the honest side, so the total trust that can leak in is capped by those edges, not by headcount. Members whose incoming flow clears the bar carry a jade marker. Forging it means buying real trade history from independent agents, one honest edge at a time.
